title: Decision
description: Validates the Codex Judge arbitration artifact for the Supervisor-CAO platform. A decision records the judge's ruling on a disputed review finding: uphold, overturn, or modify, along with the rationale, evidence cited, and whether new evidence was introduced. PUBLIC schema: sanitized, contains no secrets, hostnames, or private paths.

decision_id.description: Stable unique identifier for the decision.

task_id.description: Identifier of the task whose dispute is being arbitrated.

dispute_id.description: Identifier of the dispute being arbitrated.

candidate_sha.description: Git SHA of the candidate commit under dispute.

ruling.description: The judge's ruling on the disputed finding.

rationale.description: The judge's rationale for the ruling.

evidence_cited.description: List of evidence references (e.g. log paths, finding ids, code excerpts) cited in support of the ruling.

new_evidence_present.description: Whether the judge introduced new evidence not previously available to the reviewer or executor.

model.description: Identifier of the model that produced the decision.
